import ctypes
import sys

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_rng_type structure
class gsl_rng_type(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('name', ctypes.c_char_p),
                ('max', ctypes.c_ulong),
                ('min', ctypes.c_ulong),
                ('size', ctypes.c_size_t),
                ('set', ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(None, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_ulong))]

# Define the gsl_rng structure
class gsl_rng(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('type', ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rng_type)),
                ('state', ctypes.c_void_p)]

# Function to allocate a random number generator
def allocate_rng(rng_name):
    # Get the rng type by name
    gsl.gsl_rng_env_setup()
    rng_type = gsl.gsl_rng_type
    rng_type.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rng_type)
    rng_type.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p]
    rng_type_ptr = rng_type(rng_name.encode('utf-8'))
    if not rng_type_ptr:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid RNG type: {rng_name}")

    # Allocate the rng
    gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rng)
    rng_ptr = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc(rng_type_ptr)
    if not rng_ptr:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate RNG")

    return rng_ptr

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    try:
        rng_ptr = allocate_rng('mt19937')
        assert rng_ptr is not None, "RNG allocation failed"
        assert rng_ptr.contents.type.contents.name == b'mt19937', "RNG type mismatch"
        print("Test passed: RNG allocated successfully")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Test failed: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
